about: The official list of 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden), as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this guide was made. Names, descriptions and grades are the official text; every guide below is written for this app and names its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Plan the whole run around A Long Road (100% completion), because that gold trophy is the last one most players earn. Follow the Roadmap tab in this app: one playthrough is enough, and no trophy needs online play or a difficulty setting.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; work done earlier still counts toward it. The checklist asks for more than the trophies do in places — 300 stunts rather than 250, 70 of the 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations — so treat the trophy targets as milestones, not the finish line. Leave this for the end of the roadmap and mop up category by category.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the game's stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps, and each one you complete adds to the counter this trophy tracks. They are spread over the whole state, so work through them region by region once flying and fast cars are easy to get. Keep going past 250 if you are chasing 100% completion, which asks for 300.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks 42 Shooting Range challenges for this one, split across the game's two shooting ranges, and every one of them needs a gold medal. Learn each challenge's target pattern with a few practice runs before going for gold, and use Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) where a challenge allows it to steady a difficult string. This is the list's hardest pure-skill trophy, so save it for when your shooting stats and weapon handling are built up.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard holds it open. Bring your partner, because the cash bags are too many to carry alone, and expect a 4-star Wanted Level the moment you leave — the trophy only counts vaults you escape from. Five escapes earn the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all eight vaults.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands — a strand is one stranger's whole chain of missions, not a single job. Not every strand counts: the strands belonging to Andy, Billy and Tyrone have their own trophies and do not add to this counter, so check the trophy's progress after each strand you finish. One warning: the Race Against Yago race in Yago's Chapter 3 strand is time-sensitive (it carries an hourglass icon), so race it as soon as it appears rather than leaving it for the cleanup.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in themed sets; finishing any three complete sets earns the trophy. Pick up every card you spot while exploring rather than leaving them all for the end, and use the counter in the tracker here to see how the sets are progressing. Cards also feed the 100% completion checklist, so none of the hunting is wasted.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Across the state there are marked spots where you use the WAiNK app — 100 of them are needed here. They are quick interactions, so the efficient way is to clear them district by district whenever you are already in an area for story or collectibles, instead of making 100 separate trips at the end. Scanning vehicles with the same app is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good, so do both as you travel.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 types of activity, and you only have to try each type a single time — no wins or medals needed. You can watch what you have covered under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, where scrolling over an activity shows how many times you have done it. Most types turn up naturally as the map opens; check the menu late in the story and sample whatever is still at zero.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races must be won — repeating the same race twenty times does not work, because the counter tracks distinct races. Work through the race markers on the map as they unlock, and bring a suitable upgraded vehicle for each class. Race wins also move the 100% checklist, and the time-sensitive Race Against Yago strand race in Chapter 3 is one you should not postpone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need your partner beside you, so this opens once character switching and calling your partner in arrive after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. The natural place is a bank vault job: vaults hand you a 4-star Wanted Level as you leave, and if your partner is with you, escaping that chase earns this trophy at the same time as progress toward Maximum Withdrawal. It pops once you have fully left the red heat zone, not merely the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, rob a shop, and go straight to the next one while the police are still actively chasing you — if the stars fade and you drop into the red heat zone, the chain breaks and the count restarts. Pick three shops close together so travel time never lets the Wanted Level lapse. The trophy can take around 30 seconds to appear after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before robbing a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered when you get in it or scan it with the WAiNK app, and scanning passing traffic as you drive is the fastest way to build the count. One hundred discoveries earn the trophy; the 100% checklist asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning new shapes — parked exotics, emergency vehicles, boats and aircraft all count toward the same habit.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map by visiting every part of the state of Leonida. This comes almost free if you work through the collectibles, WAiNK spots, stunts and stranger strands region by region, because together they take you everywhere. If a patch of map is still fogged late in the game, a slow flight or drive through that area clears it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are nine gangs, and you must rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of them — robbing the same gang twice does not advance the counter. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy pops on the way if you clear operations as you find them. Watch which gang owns an operation before you hit it, and prioritise gangs you have not covered yet.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from bank jobs and payday loan robberies; you launder them by selling them on to your contacts, and the $250,000 total is cumulative across the whole game. Never sit on marked bills — sell them after every job that produces them and the total climbs steadily alongside Maximum Withdrawal and the other robbery trophies. The progress counter in this tracker uses dollars, matching the in-game total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations, and you need at least one win at each of them — a win at the same location twice does not cover a new one. Learn each course with a sighting run first; drone races are about clean lines through the gates rather than raw speed. Tick the locations off in the tracker here as you win them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Every dollar spent in any kind of shop counts toward the same $100,000 total — clothes, weapons, vehicle work, food and services all add up. It needs no special farming: between the garages for Little Boxes (about $160,000 on their own) and normal play, most players pass this total without noticing. If you are short late in the game, vehicle upgrades and property spending close the gap quickly.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages sold through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost roughly $160,000. Garages the story hands you do not count — only the eight purchases do. Buy them before grinding On the Spot, because every registered vehicle needs a free garage space to live in.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars fitted with a standard tracker at a Pay 'n' Spray. Each registered car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (Little Boxes) and register cheap cars to fill the ten quickly.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also covers fishing for Master of None. Go in with the best rod and bait you have unlocked, and play it patiently — challenges are scored on the catch, so losing a hooked fish to a snapped line costs more than a slow, safe landing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: There are four in-game arcade games in the world, and finishing any one of them to completion earns this trophy — a quick, early win. Play one through to its end rather than quitting at a high score; completion, not score, is what the trophy asks for. It also ticks arcade games off the activity list for Master of None.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one trophy in the game you can lock yourself out of. There are 18 meditation spots (they show as purple icons when you are close), and one of them is Lucia's balcony meditation during Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — and she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate; follow her and accept the optional task. It disappears when Chapter 1 ends, and with no mission replay there is no way back, so do it before finishing the chapter and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy is safe. Everywhere else, meditate with both characters where you can: each outdoor spot should count twice, once per character, if your partner is with you.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim, triggered with L3 + R3 while aiming. You need five takedowns inside one activation, so set it up: find a packed group of enemies — the guards at a gang's Illegal Operation are ideal — line up an assault rifle, then trigger Focus and work across the group. Adrenaline extends Focus, so pop it before you start if a fight is going badly.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Jewelry store robberies open with the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun. Use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in trips the alarm and ruins the attempt. Inside the back room, find the note carrying the safe code, open the safe and leave unseen; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If anyone spots you, reload a save rather than pushing on.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Pick an armored truck, get its doors open and take the cash, then lose the police completely — like Hot Together, this only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Armored trucks also feed the Marked Bills supply for Dime on the Dollar, so rob them whenever one crosses your path rather than hunting one down specially.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are listed in the game under Progress > Challenges, and there are 80 of them; 50 completions earn this trophy. Many finish on their own as you play the story, rob, race and explore, so check the menu before grinding anything specific. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so keep the remaining ones in mind during the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: it unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, and it cannot be missed. Chapter trophies in this game can appear at the start of the following chapter rather than on the final cutscene, so do not worry if the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Before you close the chapter out, do the one missable job in the game: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude in this guide), and make a manual save at the chapter's end. The trophy itself is unmissable and pops as the chapter completes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story; the trophy actually pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City), which is how this game's chapter trophies are timed. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: character switching arrives after Breakfast Run, the Scooter Bros app opens with Moses, and the Vice City Real Estate app unlocks after Daily Driver. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, as there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story; the trophy pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life). Chapter 3 unlocks the robbery toolkit — jewelry jobs with Yasmani and the Snap Gun — and carries the time-sensitive Race Against Yago strand race, so race that the moment it appears. Make your chapter-start manual save before beginning.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Late in this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens up bank vault robberies, which feed Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together, so pick it up before pushing into the endgame. Keep the usual chapter-start save, plus one spare slot you never overwrite.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final story mission. Before you start it, save into a slot you will not overwrite: with no mission replay and no New Game Plus, a pre-finale save is your insurance for anything you want to revisit. Everything outside the story — side finales, collectibles, the 100% checklist — stays available after the credits, so finishing the story never locks the platinum away.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It matters beyond the bronze: switching between Jason and Lucia, and calling the other in as your partner, opens right after this mission, and the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best) all depend on it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the main mission The Cartel Heist. It cannot be missed if you play the story; just keep your chapter-start saves in rotation so a bad autosave never strands you.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the main mission Child's Play. Unmissable on a normal story run; the trophy pops as the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the main mission Headliners. Unmissable on a normal story run; the trophy pops as the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also where the hidden trophy Catch Me If You Can is earned in free roam, so the area is worth learning while you are here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the main mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable on a normal story run; the trophy pops as the mission completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's side storyline by completing his final mission. Side-story finales stay available after the main story ends, so this cannot be locked away by finishing the game — work through Kenton's strand whenever it suits, and it also counts toward the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks if his strand is one of the counted ones; check that trophy's progress counter after you finish.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's side storyline by completing his final mission. Note that Billy's strand is one of the ones that does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it carries this trophy of its own — finish it for the bronze itself. His finale stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side storyline by completing his final mission. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has this trophy instead — so do not rely on it for the eight-strand counter. His finale stays available after the credits, so there is no rush and no way to miss it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's side storyline by completing his final mission. Side finales remain open after the main story, so this is a cleanup-stage trophy for most players; check the Strangers & Freaks progress counter after the strand in case it is one of the counted strands.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's side storyline by completing his final mission. Tyrone's strand carries this trophy of its own, so it does not add to the Strangers & Freaks counter. His finale stays available after the credits; nothing about it is time-sensitive once the strand is open.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and works through target decks that send you after specific animals; the trophy needs one of the unique animals. Take the shot carefully — a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what Bret's hunts reward. The questline stays open after the story, so it fits the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Climb in, back out toward the runway and take off; the trophy is delayed and pops once you are about a kilometre away from the airport. Save first, because the police response is fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cryptic description is the hint: a Rhino is a military tank, and this trophy is about getting into one. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save before you go in — the base will not welcome you — then climb in and drive and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you first visit in Chapter 2. Rob it thoroughly: take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind the operation resets and returns later, so this one is not missable even if a first attempt goes wrong.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description points at the pair: this pops when Jason and Lucia have both reached maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner called in — your partner trains alongside you, so both Strength stats climb together instead of needing two separate grinds. Beach gyms and indoor gyms both work; keep sessions regular while you do other things in the area.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks 500 for this one: it counts actions that change your Criminal Profile, and robberies and fights feed it constantly. In practice it fills up on its own during a normal playthrough — by the cleanup stage most players are already there. If it is somehow short at the end, a run of robberies and illegal operations is the fastest way to top it up.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: find the cocktail spot on Ocean Beach — a place serving drinks with a view over the water — and have a cocktail there. At the time this guide was written, the trackers list the trophy and its description but no confirmed step-by-step method beyond what the description itself says, so treat the description as the whole clue: Ocean Beach, a cocktail, a view. It is a free-roam trophy, so it can be done whenever you are in the area.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description is the method in outline: get into a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the showroom glass rather than the door. At the time this guide was written the trackers confirm the trophy and its description but publish no verified step-by-step, so experiment in free roam — a showroom car, a run-up, and straight out through the window frontage in classic style.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: One of the cryptic secret trophies: the description hints at succeeding at something on a second attempt after a first failure. At the time this guide was written, no tracker publishes a confirmed unlock method for it, so this entry deliberately does not invent one — it is listed here so your checklist is complete, and it is the kind of trophy most players will trip over by accident in free roam. If it has not popped by the cleanup stage, it is not blocking anything except itself and the platinum.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A secret trophy built around stumbling into something strange — the description is a reaction, not an instruction. At the time this guide was written, no tracker publishes a confirmed unlock method, so this guide does not invent a location for it. It sits in the checklist so the full 55 are tracked; players are expected to earn it by encountering the odd event it is tied to while exploring Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Do a melee drive-by — lean out of a moving vehicle and swing — through a group of pedestrians so the strike bowls several of them over in one pass, like pins. A crowded pavement at low speed gives you the densest target and the control to line the swing up. Expect a Wanted Level for it, so be ready to leave the area straight after.

roadmap.summary: One playthrough is enough for the platinum: there are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals, and the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. The run is long rather than hard — published estimates put the platinum at roughly 150 to 200 hours, most of it the 100% completion checklist behind A Long Road. Protect the run with manual saves: the game gives 15 manual slots plus one autosave, so keep one save at the start of every chapter and one from just before the final mission, and never use cheats on your trophy save, because cheats switch trophies and saving off.
roadmap.difficulty: 3 / 10 — long, not hard; The Shootist (42 Shooting Range gold medals) is the main skill test

steps.title: Chapter 1 — start clean, save the missable
steps.detail: Play the story from the start and finish Gone Fishing and Chapter 1 (Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost). In this chapter, do the game's one missable job: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and vanishes when the chapter ends. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter and another before it ends, and keep the Chapter 1 save until the platinum is done.

steps.title: Chapters 2–3 — the game opens up
steps.detail: Finish Breakfast Run to unlock character switching and your partner, then Chapters 2 and 3. Open the systems the trophies hang on: the Scooter Bros app (Moses), the Vice City Real Estate app (after Daily Driver), jewelry robberies (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs and the Snap Gun), and the first partner robberies. Race the time-sensitive Race Against Yago strand race the moment it appears in Chapter 3. Chapter-start manual saves, as always.

steps.title: Chapter 4 to the credits — finish the story
steps.detail: Play the story out to the final mission (You Gotta Know When to Get Off), collecting the named-mission trophies on the way. Pick up the optional That's Where The Money Is late in Chapter 4 to unlock bank vaults, and use vault escapes to earn Hot Together with your partner. Save before the final mission in a slot you never overwrite. Everything non-story stays open after the credits.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.title: Side stories and the robbery circuit
steps.detail: Finish the side characters' finales (Kenton, Billy, Andy, Randy, Tyrone) and Bret's hunting questline, and complete eight counted stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks — remembering that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count. Run the robbery circuit alongside: all 39 gang operations (Pest Control pops at one per gang), armored trucks, shop chains with your partner for Retail Therapy, and sell every batch of Marked Bills to push Dime on the Dollar to $250,000. Buy the eight garages and register ten vehicles on the way.

steps.title: Collectibles, activities and the grinds
steps.detail: Clear the map-based work region by region: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, the remaining meditation spots, 100 discovered vehicles and the whole map uncovered. Then the counters: 250 stunts, 50 Challenges, 20 different race wins, a win at all 14 Top Fun drone locations, Cal's fishing challenge, both characters at maximum Strength, and the secret free-roam trophies (the VCIA jet, the Mile Zero tank, the showroom escape, the melee drive-by). Save The Shootist's 42 gold medals for when your shooting is sharpest.

steps.title: 100% cleanup and the platinum
steps.detail: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist down category by category — it asks for more than the trophies in places (300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 vaults, all 39 operations, 200 vehicles). When A Long Road pops at 100%, Vice Got a Price! follows immediately if everything else is done. Anything still missing shows in this tracker with its filter set to Not earned.
